text:
Situation: Mannitol has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-09-23, totaling 61 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East has 12 days on hand and Corvale General has 13 days on hand at current usage rates. Specific stock: Corvale East MANNITOL 20G00ML 60 units (15.7 days), MANNITOL 10G00ML 500ML BAG 39 units (8.2 days); Corvale General MANNITOL 54.17 units (12.8 days), Mannitol 53.71 units (12.5 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows mannitol listed continuously since 2021-09-23. A registered plant on our labels, Baxter Healthcare Corporation (FEI 1416980), received an OAI classification on 2026-04-02; the inspection occurred 22 days before that posting date. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2026-09-29.

Our position: Current inventory is insufficient to sustain operations beyond two weeks. Alternative suppliers not on FDA's shortage list are available. The Baxter plant's regulatory history presents ongoing supply risk.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (not on FDA shortage list; plant last VAI 2023-10-13). Requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Hospira, Inc. as secondary source (not on FDA shortage list; plant last NAI 2025-02-07). Requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to evaluate ICU Medical Inc., HF Acquisition Co LLC, and Henry Schein, Inc. for formulary addition. Requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending Baxter supply recovery; relying solely on current inventory without active alternative sourcing.
